# Conformance: Fermium 1.5 (Python, the oracle)

**3366 of 3366 programs pass (100.0 %)**, generated by `conformance/run --impl legacy` in 651 s.

The suite (conformance/cases, see conformance/MANIFEST.md) was harvested from Fermium 1.5: every program the
test suite runs, every example, rosetta, gauntlet and research program, the benchmarks, and John's Appendix 1
programs. Comparison (D264): output exactly, except that a number with a decimal point or a power of ten
may differ by one unit in its last digit when it has the same shape; errors with the same message, line and
hint; the same warnings; the same exit code.
